name: workflow-tools
description: Codex planning, independent Claude counsel, explanation, and explicit toolbox shipping skills.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, consult, explain, and safely ship changes.
interface.longDescription: Workflow Tools packages Claude Counselor for bounded independent planning and code review, Explain Clearly for concise explanations, Deep Planning for adversarial Plan Mode critique, and Ship Toolbox for explicit validation, commit, push, CI, and local marketplace refresh workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use $explain-clearly to answer directly, adapt the depth to my question, and add examples or visuals only when they help.
Use $deep-planning to critique this plan before implementation.
Use $claude-counselor for bounded independent planning and final code review on major work.
Use $ship-toolbox to validate, commit, push, refresh, and verify the current toolbox changes.
Review this Plan Mode request for assumptions, risks, and routing.
